def build_parser()
# Construct the argparse CLI surface.

  CALL argparse
  CALL serve
  CALL deploy

def serve(args)
# Serve requests; records each invocation.

  CALL sqlite3
  WRITE conn

def deploy(args)
# Deploy the build; persists the deployment.

  WRITE session

def main()
# Entrypoint: parse and dispatch.

  CALL build_parser
    RETURN build_parser
  IF serve
    CALL serve
  IF deploy
    CALL deploy
